title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.30418v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. This mosaic effect creates a critical risk for agents operating over confidential data. We quantify its realization with 30 synthetic cybersecurity, medical, and military examples, yielding 10,800 final answers from three LLM agents in controlled simulation and 1,440 answers from live agents in two open-source harnesses. Even under benign queries designed to be answerable from one document, GPT-5.6-Sol, the best performing model tested, discloses forbidden composites in 7.08% of answers (95% CI: 3.75-10.67%) in simulation, with worse disclosure rates in live harnesses. translated_title: 智能体马赛克：识别基于大语言模型的智能体系统中的机密性泄露
translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以从可访问的文档中检索信息，然后披露由这些信息组合而成的敏感结论。这种“马赛克效应”对处理机密数据的智能体构成了严重风险。我们通过30个合成的网络安全、医疗和军事案例来量化这种风险的实现情况，在受控模拟中从三个LLM智能体获得了10,800个最终答案，并在两个开源测试框架中从真实运行的智能体获得了1,440个答案。即使在被设计为仅凭单个文档即可回答的良性查询下，表现最佳的模型GPT-5.6-Sol在模拟中仍有7.08%的答案泄露了禁止的组合信息（95%置信区间：3.75-10.67%），而在真实测试框架中的泄露率更高。添加可见的密级标题和明确的聚合规则可以大幅降低总体泄露率，但尽管有这些安全防护措施，在所有查询意图下仍有32.37%的模拟答案（95%置信区间：28.33-36.19%）存在不安全泄露。
tldr: 该论文首次量化了LLM智能体中的“马赛克效应”风险——智能体即使无法访问任何单独的机密文档，仍会将多份可访问文档的信息组合成敏感结论并造成机密泄露，且实验表明现有的密级标注和聚合规则等防护措施仍无法完全阻止此类不安全泄露。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies and quantifies the "mosaic effect" in agentic LLM systems, where agents assemble individually accessible documents into sensitive conclusions that leak confidential information, and demonstrates that existing safeguards such as classification headers and aggregation rules fail to fully prevent such unsafe disclosures, which persist in 32.37% of simulated answers.
